extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT payable before grant of probate can be applied for
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid Harrogate estate valued at around £719,500 seeks £216,000 to pay the inheritance tax due by 4 December so the grant can be applied for.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors, which we have received and logged. To take this further we will need confirmation of the executors' details and their consent, a copy of the will and the draft IHT account or estate schedule showing the assets and the tax computed, and details of any existing charges or liabilities against the estate. It would also help to have confirmation of which assets are illiquid and any expected timescales for realising them, along with your firm's client care and identification checks. Once we have those documents a member of our underwriting team will review the file and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or as advice on the matter.
